values.note: Reservations for the 2027 season open January 5, 2027 at 9 am CST. A camper arriving without a reservation self-registers at the station by the entrance for any unreserved site. Cancelling 31+ days out costs $35, 10-30 days $45, and 9 days or less forfeits the stay.

booking.source: https://www.vilascountyrec.com/policies (Torch Lake: 'If you arrive and the host is not available and you do not have a reservation, use a self-registration station'; 'post the upper receipt portion at any non-reserved site'; 'No one may camp ... for more than 21 days per site'; cancellation fees $35.00 / $45.00 / forfeit); https://www.vilascountyrec.com/ (2027 reservation banner), read 2026-11-16

note: Vilas County campground near Conover, a short walk by path from the beach at Torch Lake Park, with direct access to the county's ATV and UTV trail system and an ATV wash station. --Claude
summary: Vilas County pages read: $45/$50 confirmed (stored), 41 sites (1-20 W/E, 21-41 full hookup), shower house, flush toilets, dump, Wi-Fi, 21-day limit, walk-in self-registration on unreserved sites, 2027 bookings open Jan 5. Not waterfront kept. Google 4.9 (105).
flags: OHV (reviewer, not a drop by itself): the county markets 'direct access to the Vilas County ATV Trail System' and has an ATV/UTV wash station, but this is a general county campground (41 hookup sites, shower house, beach) with an OHV side, not a staging or trail-base camp. Keep.
FEES confirmed as stored: 'Rates: $45/50 per night' on the county page (2026-11-16). Campspot isn't open for 2027 dates yet ('This campground isn't taking reservations for those dates').
HOOKUPS: electric 50 (derived) left - the county page doesn't give amps; the stored Campspot site types (read 2026-10-13) name '30/50 Amp' sites.
SEASON: stored 05-16..10-11 (from Campspot, 2026-10-13) left; no county page states the 2027 dates.
SITES: the map's lengths are driveway lengths (74-386 ft), not a rig limit, so max_rig_ft stays unset.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept - Torch Lake is ~150 m north through forest from the nearest sites; the swim area is a park beach reached by path.
PIN: stored 46.0197,-89.2745 is the campground entrance on Torch Lake Road; the sites centre ~46.0192,-89.2725 (~160 m). Fine.

WEBSITE: lines confirmed (vilascountyrec.com/torch-lake + Campspot). Vilas County also keeps a page at https://www.vilascountywi.gov/departments/services/parks_and_recreation/campgrounds/torch_lake_campground___rv_park.php (the one Google links). PHONE 715-479-5160 confirmed (Google).

LEADS: none of Vilas County's other campgrounds is in the DB (checked by name). The county describes them as Tamarack Springs 'rustic camping ... trailhead for the Off-Highway Motorcycle trail system' (likely OHV-base, out), Buckatabon Creek 'rustic campsites perfect for tent campers', Rummels Road 'primitive, secluded campsites ideal for quiet tent camping' (tent-oriented) and River Road (equestrian, out) - probably none qualifies; not vetted.
